# HummingBeing — Coaching & Somatics

> HummingBeing is the somatic wellness practice of Isabelle Claus Teixeira, a Global TRE™ Certifying Trainer, ICF PCC Executive Coach and Somatic Coach with 30 years of human development experience across 9 countries and 40+ nationalities. HummingBeing offers TRE™ (Tension & Trauma Releasing Exercises), Coaching and Mindfulness — in person and online worldwide — to help people release chronic stress, prevent burnout, regulate the nervous system and build resilience. Part of Business and Human Development Consulting Pte Ltd.

## Key facts

- Founder & lead practitioner: Isabelle Claus Teixeira — Global TRE™ Certifying Trainer (trained under Dr. David Berceli), ICF PCC, Strozzi Somatic Bodywork Practitioner, Reiki Level II.
- Core offerings: TRE™ exercises, Somatic & Executive Coaching, Mindfulness, and the Global TRE™ Provider Certification (train to teach TRE™).
- Delivery: in person and online worldwide (clients across Europe, the US and Asia).
- Contact: isabelle@bhdasia.com · WhatsApp +81 80-6515-1778.

## Services

- [Holistic Mastermind Ecosystem](https://hummingbeing.com/holistic-mastermind.html): A four-pillar framework (mind, body, energy, vision) for high-performing leaders.
- [Global TRE™ Provider Certification](https://hummingbeing.com/tre-certification.html): A 3-module pathway to become a Certified TRE™ Provider. The 2026 intake is closed; the 2027 Singapore cohort begins 27–28 February 2027, co-taught by Isabelle Claus Teixeira and Simba Stenqvist.
- [Retreats & Workshops](https://hummingbeing.com/retreats-workshops.html): Immersive somatic wellness retreats — TRE™, Somatic Healing and Breathwork.
- [Book a Session](https://hummingbeing.com/book.html): The 8-Week Coaching Package (S$2,300) or a free 30-minute discovery call.

## What is TRE™?

TRE™ (Tension, Stress & Trauma Releasing Exercises) is a body-led series of simple exercises, created by Dr. David Berceli, that activate the body's natural tremor reflex to release deep muscular tension and calm the nervous system. Reported benefits include better sleep, more energy, sharper focus, greater emotional calm, reduced anxiety, and relief from stress-related physical pain.
